profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Software Engineer working on Ads personalization. Graduated from Mount Holyoke College in May of 2019 with a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science and Mathematics. Visiting student at University of Edinburgh in Spring 2018.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Part of the YouTube Ads organization with a focus on ad personalization using ML models.

positions.title: Engineering Resident
positions.description: As an engineering resident I spent 4.5 months on one of the core teams in Google Shopping, developing an event batching service currently used to batch requests for email. The main goal of the project was to reduce the number of emails customers of Google Shopping receive per order. This project involved setting up and maintaining a database, using Guice and Promises (internal technology for Java, similar to JavaScript Promises). I ramped up quickly and met the requirements for early conversion from a resident to a full-time employee.

positions.title: Peer Mentor
positions.description:
Led active learning modules for introductory CS courses with 50+ students. 
Mentored 10+ students, did code reviews for their CS assignments, held weekly 1-on-1 discussion meetings.

positions.title: Summer Analyst
positions.description:
Technology summer analyst on the FICC Risk team at Goldman Sachs. Collaborated with senior developers to increase performance for the risk computing distributed state machine.
Designed and implemented an open tracing API to highlight the system’s critical path and to facilitate debugging. Used cURL to asynchronously post tracing information to Zipkin via HTTP requests.
Integrated API with Java Brave open-source library to make continuous Java traces with Slang (internal language)

positions.title: Lead UX/UI Intern
positions.description:
Worked on a team of 7 to build a 2D mobile game in C# in Unity. My position was related to UX/UI but I also contributed to the implementation of the functionalities of the game . Wrote the weekly blog post where each team reflected on the work done and the accomplishments made. 
Collaborated with 21 more people on 4 other mobile games.  Managed and organized project goals with my teammates.

honors.title: Business Innovation Award
honors.description:
Built a demo for ExerSperience, a story-driven Android app to motivate sports enthusiast during their training session.
Used creative skills in design, logo and slide presentation. Our team of 3 implemented the demo in Android Studio.

volunteerExperiences.role: Collected, sorted and distributed food for people in need in the Hadley region

This is an article about the event that contains a short story about my experience

company.name: Bag the Community, South Hadley’s annual food drive

volunteerExperiences.description: The Computer Science department at Mount Holyoke College annually invites high school girls for a day to learn more about tech and engage in various tech-related activities. My role as a student mentor is to lead a group of 10-15 high school girls. Together we attend talks, participate in hardware/software workshops and learn about the opportunities for women in tech.

projects.title: MaGE peer mentoring program, Sponsored by Google
projects.description:
Collaboratively created an Active Learning Module (ALM) on Memory Drawing
As a pilot in Fall 2017, 4 instructors started teaching Computer Science to 80 students with our ALM
The mentoring program focused on writing the best code as a team

organizations.name: KSO Diana
organizations.description:
Orienteering Sports Club
Participated in various races
Won South Eastern Orienteering Championship in Belgrade, Serbia, in 2014
Have helped organize multiple running events
Have volunteered at events in my hometown, Yambol, as a member of this club
